scientific_integrity: Exact finite-size proof provided; verification enumerates through n=8 only and is not an infinite proof. No independent verification or authorship claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Results concern deterministic linear scores of the position- and value-descent profiles under the uniform law only; no conditional independence, nonlinear maximal correlation, or originality beyond available comparisons is claimed. Foulkes's classical joint descent-composition enumeration may allow an implicit derivation; independent historical assessment is outstanding.
title: Sharp linear predictability between descents and inverse descents of a uniform permutation
